citations.desc: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
citations.narrative:
The semi-annual report to the Institutional Official which was dated May 15, 2026 had not been signed by the IACUC
members. Signatures of the IACUC members ensure that the report is a reflection of appropriate oversight of the animal
care and use program by the IACUC. The facility must ensure that the reports to the Institutional Official are signed by the
IACUC .The reports shall be reviewed and signed by a majority of the IACUC members and must include any minority
views.
*******Correct by August 1, 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
